question: Which of the following is the maximum file size that can be attached to an email message in Gmail?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25 MB**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **25 MB** is the maximum file size that can be attached to an email message in Gmail.
 
• If your file is larger than 25 MB, Gmail automatically uploads it to Google Drive and includes a download link in the email.
 
• This limit applies to both incoming and outgoing email messages.
